# Repository instructions for parabula-next

**The single, binding source of rules, memory, and project map is [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repo root.**

Read `CLAUDE.md` in full before any action. Do not duplicate its rules here or in any
other file (see `CLAUDE.md` §0 and §19 — a single rules source is enforced by
`npm run rules:check`). This file intentionally holds no rules of its own; it only
points to `CLAUDE.md`.
